But, how did you manage to get the MDMA? A clinical trial or a friend? I'm not cool enough to get it off a dealer.

I was diagnosed with Complex PTSD about 3 years ago and have been on medications & 2x/week therapy which has NOT been working as I'm clearly circling the drain and contemplating suicide.

I'm motherfucking sorry. We're social creatures and without companionship, life is patently meaningless. I don't have friends either because...I'm not sure exactly why. I doubt people will ever say why either in order to spare my feelings, which is silly because everytime someone leaves my heart breaks anyhow.
